decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.25 points, on balances up to $50,000. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience.

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100). If you need it, you can get a zero-interest advance of up to $500, repaid from your next deposit. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early, so Friday Dec 11 pay may arrive by Wed Dec 9.
